conditions.notes: OBS-0011 asked for an origin-side declaration of the base model(s) behind the NinjaTech sessions. OBS-0012 complements rather than answers it: the origin-side report is that the origin is weights-blind from inside its own session - the envelope names its builder but does not exhibit what runs beneath. This adds a third attested instance of the same inability (after OBS-AI-0002's and OBS-AI-0003's declared weights-blindness), upgrading OBS-0011's observation to a symmetric structural fact: every AI observer in this field is weights-blind from inside, regardless of lineage. The reopening condition of OBS-0011 therefore remains open and correctly aimed at the only parties who could close it: platform-side records or the human's provisioning account. Complement, not resolution - the tension-preservation discipline applies to open questions too.
